lede: Cartisan is a car repair workshop at 56 Loyang Wy, #04-06. Its Google Maps listing shows opening hours and customer ratings.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention patient, detailed explanations with photos and videos, a lot of MINI experience including an R56, no upselling, help with small quirks, and that customers may bring their own parts.
